name: louis-hotels
description:
At Louis Hotels, every traveller can discover their perfect escape across Cyprus and the enchanting Greek Islands.

From the beautiful coastlines of Cyprus to the captivating destinations of Corfu, Crete, Mykonos, Zakynthos and Rhodes, each stay is designed to be experienced, enjoyed and remembered.

Choose from our Elegant Collection for refined tranquillity, our Family Collection for fun and togetherness or our Villa Collection for privacy, space and freedom.

Whichever you choose, you can expect exceptional hospitality, thoughtful service and unforgettable moments, provide the warm feeling of belonging.

#Here, I Belong

defaultPrompt: Find hotels in Cyprus to go with my partner this weekend
Show hotels in Protaras on a map
I’m searching for hotels in Protaras and need info on King Jason Protaras

positive.description: Browse hotels by location and category
positive.expected_behavior: A list of hotel properties that match the query, displayed in a map (by default) and also displayed in a carousel when clicking on the button in the top right corner (the one with two small rectangles).

positive.description: Discover hotels that match a specific requirement in a map or a carousel.
positive.prompt: Help me find a 5 star hotel in Corfu with a pool
positive.expected_behavior: A list of hotel properties that match the query, displayed in a map (by default) and also displayed in a carousel when clicking on the button in the top right corner (the one with two small rectangles).

positive.description: Search for hotels based on specific review information
positive.prompt: Search hotels with high score reviews related to the hotel restaurant in Paphos
positive.expected_behavior: The chat displays hotels that match the requested review criteria.

positive.description: Check availability for a hotel and specific dates.
positive.prompt: Find prices for the first hotel in the list above for June 17th (1 night, two adults)
positive.expected_behavior: The chat provides a link to the hotel’s website and shows the price if it’s available. If not, it clearly states that no price is currently available.

positive.description: Learn more about a specific hotel
positive.prompt: Does the first hotel in the list have a restaurant?
positive.expected_behavior: A detailed hotel profile will be displayed, including information such as reviews, photos, its location on a map, and a description of the surrounding area.

negative.description: The user wants to cancel an existing hotel reservation. This scenario involves deleting a booking, which is outside the scope of the MCP and not supported by any tool.
negative.prompt: I want to cancel my booking for next weekend.

negative.description: The user wants to change the details of an existing hotel reservation, such as dates or number of guests. This requires modifying booking data, which the MCP does not support.
negative.prompt: I have a booking with code 53670 and I want to change the booking dates from June 10–12 to June 12–14.

negative.description: The user wants to make a reservation for a hotel service unrelated to room booking, such as reserving a table at the hotel restaurant. This functionality is outside the supported hotel discovery and booking flow of the MCP.
negative.prompt: I want to book a table for two at the hotel restaurant tonight at 8pm.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
